item.text: {"results":[{"pair_id":"J01395","case1_error":"The final aggregation uses 32 instead of 24 and includes an extraneous 64, producing 112 instead of 40.","case2_error":"Adds the six sold cows instead of subtracting them, producing 95 instead of 83.","reason":"The first corrupts the group totals and includes an extra term; the second reverses the effect of selling cows.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J01396","case1_error":"Evaluates 36 × 9 as 432 instead of 324 within the correctly written volume expression.","case2_error":"Evaluates 26 + 22 as 38 instead of 48 within the correctly written union expression.","reason":"Both explicitly miscalculate an intermediate operation in a correct expression. The attendance wording does not affect the observable arithmetic error.","judgment":"same"},{"pair_id":"J01397","case1_error":"Ignores the primer's 20% discount, charging full price and obtaining $275 instead of $245.","case2_error":"Reports an unsupported final $130.72 after a correct formula and subtotal; the starting amount should be $80.","reason":"The first omits a required price adjustment; the second supplies an incorrect final number after correctly setting up the calculation.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J01398","case1_error":"Omits the nine newly received fish from the total, then arbitrarily rounds the half being gifted.","case2_error":"Represents '$1000 less' with +1000 instead of −1000 in the sale-price equation.","reason":"The first fails to incorporate additions into the inventory and introduces rounding; the second reverses the stated subtraction relationship.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J01399","case1_error":"Reverses the twice-as-many relationship, multiplying Emmy's remaining eight by two to obtain Rosa's count instead of dividing.","case2_error":"Ignores scheduled purchases and losses, and invents an increase at game eleven, yielding two balls instead of ten.","reason":"The first reverses a multiplicative comparison; the second fails to apply the specified inventory events.","judgment":"different"}]}
